name: 雨水対策を検討する委員会を設置
summary: 気候変動を踏まえた雨水対策の方針づくりに必要な事項を調べ、話し合う委員会を新たに設けます。委員は8人以内とし、委員の任期は委嘱された日から令和10年3月31日までです。条例は令和8年4月1日に施行します。
changes: 雨水対策検討委員会を設置する
委員を学識経験者と関係行政機関の職員から選ぶ
委員の任期を委嘱された日から令和10年3月31日までとする
why: 雨水対策検討委員会を設置するためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Sets up a committee to consider rainwater measures
en.official: Regarding the Enactment of an Ordinance Partially Amending the Kawasaki City Ordinance on the Establishment of Affiliated Bodies
en.summary: The city will set up a new committee to examine and discuss matters needed to develop a policy on rainwater measures in light of climate change. The committee will have no more than 8 members. Members will serve from the date they are appointed through March 31, 2028. The ordinance will take effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Set up the Rainwater Measures Review Committee
Select members from among people with academic expertise and staff of relevant administrative bodies
Set members’ terms from the date they are appointed through March 31, 2028
who: People with academic expertise and staff of relevant administrative bodies
en.why: The city says this is to establish the Rainwater Measures Review Committee.
